statement: Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping hold an in-person trilateral meeting, all three present together, in China between 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-21, around the APEC Leaders Meeting in Shenzhen on 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-19.
